problem: The rehabilitation had no written definition of better. Recovery proved the repository can produce coherent, individually defensible mechanisms that are collectively wrong - seven ingestion paths, four chart models, two grammars, two definitions of live - because every generation re-derived its own quality criteria and each derived a different one. PHASE-004 would have designed the canonical architecture against criteria invented while designing it, and PHASE-003 would have compared artifacts against criteria invented while comparing them.
scope: Knowledge and governance only: the architecture quality benchmark and the automation classification model as new governed artifacts under docs/standards, the standards disposition matrix and domain-profile routing added to the existing owner docs/reference/engineering/STANDARDS.md, the DEF-04 object-storage responsibility row in the CAD-02 authority registry, the DEF-01 wiring of the control-plane validator into the existing CI workflow, the control-plane state (CURRENT, MANIFEST, CATALOG, ADOPTION, two work items), and the supersession of the repository-control-protocol card, whose covered control-plane files this change edits. No application code, schema, migration, contract, package, runtime configuration or test was touched, and no part of the Canonical Architecture was designed.

impact: PHASE-003 now evaluates artifacts with a fixed verdict method instead of fresh criteria; PHASE-004 inherits hard invariants and a rejection list; PHASE-007 gains a benchmark an adversarial reviewer can apply without inventing quality criteria; PHASE-012 re-runs the same conditions. The CAD-02 registry gains its first responsibility row added after recovery closed, with bounded evidence and an explicit UNVERIFIED residual. DEF-01 and DEF-04 are closed, DEF-05 was checked and its trigger has not fired, DEF-08 fired and is escalated to the owner as TASK-002. The superseded card's remaining files (AGENTS.md, the validator, its three test suites, ADR-013, the protocol spec, the work mechanism, REC-CONSOLIDATION) lose VERIFIED review-range coverage; none of them changed here, so no range limited to this phase is affected, and a range that touches them would have needed its own card regardless.
compatibility: No runtime contract, schema, migration, API surface, package or deployment artifact is affected, so no consumer compatibility question arises. Documents were classified and extended in place; no document was moved, merged, superseded or deleted, so every inbound reference and every piece of historical evidence remains valid. One change record was superseded rather than rewritten: repository-control-protocol now carries status SUPERSEDED and supersededBy this card, because PHASE-002 edited four files it covered; its evidence, digests and test records are untouched and stay true of the state they described. The added CI step is additive and independent of the existing jobs.
failure: Both validators fail closed and both now run in CI: an unresolved reference, missing authority, vocabulary violation, roadmap gap, duplicate canonical owner, stale evidence digest or uncovered changed path exits non-zero. Rollback is deletion of the two docs/standards artifacts, the card and evidence directories and the two work items, plus reverting the edits to STANDARDS.md, the CAD doctrine, the CI workflow and the four control-plane files. No data, migration or runtime state is involved, so rollback is textual and complete.
security: No credential, database, network or deployment surface is touched. The added CI step runs a stdlib-only validator that reads repository text and executes nothing it reads; workflow permissions are unchanged (contents: read, pull-requests: read) and no secret is referenced. The object-storage classification records where content identity lives; it changes no access path and grants no permission.
